newsitem.title: USA: Upland Energy completing Kansas well.
newsitem.headline: Upland Energy completing Kansas well.

text.p: Upland Energy Corp said it has set production casing to a depth of 3,332 feet in the Lewis H-1 well in its Hittle Field in Cowley County, southern Kansas.

It said a number of cores with good to excellent oil shows were collected; and well data indicate oil of high gravity in a formation with excellent porosity and permeability. The well cut more than 45 feet of potential oil sands, Upland said.
The company said it expects the well will be placed into production in late December or early January.
"Once the well is placed into production, we anticipate starting drilling on additional wells in the Hittle Field," it added. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
